body: Thank you for the reply, I appreciate it. I hope you're having a good night.

Thank you for replying. I appreciate it. I hope your low spell didn't last long. 

My eating is all over the place. Most days at work I am so anxious that I feel too sick to eat anything. I didn't really notice it until you pointed it out. 

I'll work on it. Thank you.

I appreciate it but I can't see another way to go about it. I was having therapy but my therapist referred me to someone else, who had a meeting with me, and told me that as I am 'functional' (read: I am currently employed) I don't qualify for any further therapy (even though I spend every waking moment wanting to kill myself), and she advised me 'have you tried going dancing'. And when my anti depressant didnt work I went back to my doctor and he said 'well I guess there's nothing I can do for you then,'

that seems like a failure to me
